gap_notes: No gap tutor / gappie programme mentioned on the boarding pages. Hostel staffing listed as Hostel Manager plus Matron (Brenda Hall). A large (180+) state boys' hostel, so a speculative approach is reasonable.
rugby_notes: Super 8 member. Won Super 8 in 2000, 2002 and 2003; Super 8 finalist 2023. 12 National Top 4 appearances, national champions 2002, runners-up 2018 and 2022. Hurricanes Cup winners 2018, 2021 and 2022. One of the strongest rugby schools in the lower North Island.
scenery_notes: Napier: Art Deco city on Hawke Bay, Marine Parade coastline, Cape Kidnappers gannets, Hawke's Bay wine country and cycle trails nearby; Te Mata Peak about 30 min away.
notes: Headmaster: Simon Coe (since 2024, per Wikipedia/NZ Herald). Boarder count from ERO institution page https://www.ero.govt.nz/institution/216/napier-boys-high-school.

boarding_houses: Plantation House (Yrs 7-8), two Junior Houses (Yr 9 and Yr 10), Campbell House (Yr 11), Kirkpatrick House (Yr 12), Mitchell House (Yr 13): 6 houses, grouped by age
boarders_approx: c.230 (about 40% of a roll of about 560-580)
gap_notes: No formal gap programme is published. Houses run with resident Housemasters and Assistant Housemasters, and the careers page says staff have opportunities in boarding and pastoral care. A traditional boys' boarding school of this type often takes gap/assistant tutors. Also worth copying in the Director of Rugby, Andre Bell (bell.andre@lindisfarne.school.nz, verified on the 2026 staff list), given the candidate's Bath Academy background.
rugby_notes: Plays in the CNI (Central North Island) 1st XV competition; 2025 CNI 3rd-place playoff v Wesley College. Has a dedicated Director of Rugby (Andre Bell). Strong rugby tradition, with traditional fixtures against other Hawke's Bay schools.
scenery_notes: 22-hectare campus on the edge of Hastings in the Heretaunga Plains wine/orchard country; Te Mata Peak, Havelock North, Cape Kidnappers, Ocean Beach/Waimarama and the Ruahine/Kaweka ranges are all close.
source_url: https://a.storyblok.com/f/292273512629791/x/5d59f27f18/staff-contact-list.pdf (2026 Teaching Staff Contact List; house contacts at https://www.lindisfarne.school.nz/boarding)
notes: Staff email pattern is surname.firstname@lindisfarne.school.nz. Housemasters (from the boarding page): Daniel Pooley (Plantation), Henry Harland (Yr 9), Cameron Stuart (Yr 10), Tony Parker (Campbell), Fraser Harrison (Kirkpatrick), Jared Fritchley (Mitchell). town: Pukehou (near Waipukurau / Te Aute), Central Hawke's Bay
boarders_approx: c.90-120 (an older ERO report: 91 boarders = 82% of roll; now predominantly boarding)
gap_notes: No gap tutor programme found. A historic Anglican Māori boys' boarding school (founded 1854) with a strong tikanga Māori special character. An approach should show respect for and interest in the kaupapa. Hostel operation has at times reported directly to the principal (ERO).
rugby_notes: Proud rugby tradition. Plays in the CNI / Hurricanes-region schools competitions, with traditional 1st XV challenges (e.g. v Hato Pāora, 2025). Smaller roll, so not a current national contender.
scenery_notes: Rural Central Hawke's Bay farmland by Lake Roto-a-Kiwa; about 40 min to Hastings/Havelock North; Ruahine Range and the CHB coast (Pōrangahau, Blackhead) within reach.
notes: The contact page (checked Sep 2026) lists hostel@teaute.school.nz. A search-engine snippet of an older page version showed kaihautu@teaute.school.nz (kaihautū = leader/manager), but it is not on the current site, so treat it as unverified. No principal's name is published on the site.
